Tool call: code_execution
Tool call input: {'code': 'text = "We review the data establishing the use of clonazepam in the treatment of PD as well as new information, particularly confirmation of longterm efficacy and safety."\nchemical_entities = ["clonazepam"]\nprint("Chemical entities identified:", ", ".join(chemical_entities))', 'language': 'python'}
